_: The second rung of the tone ladder: where the knee landed (about 0.5) this asks how much white
to mix into a folded colour (desat), how high the ceiling should stand (white), and whether the
light the sunlit half loses should be paid back with the exposure.
Run it with the pictures kept, then ask the pictures how much a sunlit surface varies inside
itself, which is the whole point of taking the top of the picture off the ceiling:
for f in pictures/tmp/tonefine/*.png; do node tools/pixels.js $f --patch 300,180,460,260 --block 8; done
--patch over a strip of sunlit plaster, in blocks of 8 px: a wall whose trowel sweeps are being
flattened out has a small spread there, and one that is holding its pattern has a bigger one.
